body:
Cloud continuation checkpoint: PR #292 now carries the independently reviewed concrete-resource routing-history repair, published head 5ebc97c12e99ae98dacacfe8ace170620d581649. Source and PostgreSQL gates passed; public-CLI and fresh-native acceptance are assigned. PR #289's Windows child startup failure remains unresolved: head 2116a36e2015070d3b7e08a5362ed8442aee8331 adds diagnostics without weakening its concurrency barrier. PR #290's validator import-formatting fix is reviewed and pushed at a337d0b9bbb6c4babda712b39368273d77e610a9; its ten-case Linux native PASS remains bound to the older measured c782 artifact.

Core #291's non-publishing candidate-wheel job passed and its retained wheel/sdist hashes and all 48 packaged Python source files were independently verified. Registry publication is still pending. A Sol lane is reconciling the minimum #83/#86/#129 shared Run-output authorization and fenced-publication criterion required by #127/#282; legacy run-file URLs are insufficient.

Integration remains c6d729f29167f04080ab5547955d6398a6ee49d0. The retained 54-contract graph remains authoritative; no whole-issue acceptance, native release or migration is inferred from these checkpoints. Devsy was deleted and remains on HOLD until a new explicit HIT THE GAS. Cloud work continues.
